text.en:
Upon readying a Sword:
100% Increased Lunge Range within 1 second. 

Moving too fast instantly ends the effect, even without swinging the sword.

4 second cooldown.

enhanced (
#e Buff Duration is increased to 1.5 seconds.
)
text.zh-chs:
切换到此武器时：
提升 100% 刀剑前冲距离，持续 1 秒。

移动速度过快时将立即结束该效果。

冷却时间 4 秒。

enhanced (
#e 增益持续时间提升到 1.5 秒。
)
